'''Noch''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Stationed at the [[House Traders' Circle]] in [[King's Pass]], he was the partner of Agent [[Shyrack (Human)|Shyrack]].
